records.jp: それからしばらく経って……
records.en_original: Some time later...
records.en: Some time later...

records.jp: うーん、いい天気っ！
records.en_original: Wow, what a beautiful day!
records.en: Wow, what a beautiful day!

records.jp: こんなに気持ちのいい青空、久しぶりに見た気がするよ
records.en_original: It feels like it's been ages since I saw such a refreshingly blue sky.
records.en: It feels like it's been ages since I saw such a refreshingly blue sky.

records.jp: うん。ほんと、今日がいい天気でよかった。<CR>転校初日が雨だと、気分も萎えるし
records.en_original: Yeah, I'm really glad it's nice out today. If it was raining on her first day at a new school, it would be a buzzkill.
records.en: Yeah, I'm really glad it's nice out today.<CR>If it was raining on her first day at a new school, it would be a buzzkill.

records.jp: そういえば、羽成さんも転校生だったね。<CR>なんだか、すごく前だったように感じるな
records.en_original: Oh that's right, Ruka, you were a transfer student too. It feels like it's been an eternity since you came.
records.en: Oh that's right, Hanari-san, you were a transfer student too.<CR>It feels like it's been an eternity since you came.

records.jp: きっと世界も紫乃の転校を祝ってくれてるんだろ。<CR>よかったじゃねえか
records.en_original: Bet the whole world's celebrating your transfer here, right Shino?
records.en: Bet the whole world's celebrating your transfer here,<CR>right Shino?

records.jp: ふふっ、はい。<CR>青い空、とっても嬉しいです
records.en_original: Hehe, yes, it seems that way. The bright blue sky makes me really happy.
records.en: Hehe, yes.<CR>The blue sky makes me so happy.

records.jp: それにしても、大丈夫だったの？<CR>急に月ノ宮に転校なんかしちゃって
records.en_original: But are you really okay? I mean, transferring to Tsukinomiya so suddenly and all.
records.en: But are you really okay?<CR>I mean, transferring to Tsukinomiya so suddenly and all.

records.jp: どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: いや、だってイネスの初代名誉会長でしょ？<CR>何かしら問題になりそうだけど……
records.en_original: Well, weren't you the first student council president of St. Ines? I feel like that could cause some issues.
records.en: Well, aren't you the first honorary chairwoman of St. Ines?<CR>I feel like that could cause some problems...

records.jp: 名誉会長とはいっても、私は生徒なので。<CR>それに、文句を言える人もいませんから
records.en_original: Even if I am the student council president, I'm still just a student. Besides, there's really no one around who'd complain about it.
records.en: Even as honorary chairwoman, I'm still a student.<CR>Besides, there's no one around to complain.

records.jp: う～ん、それっていいことなのかなぁ？
records.en_original: Hmm, do you think that's really a good thing?
records.en: Hmm, do you think that's really a good thing?

records.jp: 他人からぶーぶー文句言われねぇんだから、<CR>いいことに決まってんだろ
records.en_original: Come on, if no one's nagging at you, that's gotta be good, right?
records.en: Come on, if no one's nagging at you,<CR>that's gotta be good, right?

records.jp: う～ん……それもそっか
records.en_original: Hmm... Yeah, I guess you're right.
records.en: Hmm... Yeah, I guess you're right.

records.jp: いや、軽すぎだから
records.en_original: No, you're way too carefree.
records.en: No, you're way too carefree.

records.jp: でも、ほんとにいい時期だよね。<CR>もう少ししたら学園祭もあるし
records.en_original: But seriously, it's a great time right now. The school festival's coming up soon, too.
records.en: But seriously, it's a great time right now.<CR>The culture festival's coming up soon too.

records.jp: 校外学習も来月だし。<CR>うん、ちょうど行事が重なる時期だ
records.en_original: And next month is the field trip. Yeah, it's really the season for all kinds of events.
records.en: And next month is the field trip.<CR>Yeah, it's really the season for all kinds of events.

records.jp: その前に中間テストもあるしね
records.en_original: But before that, we've got midterms.
records.en: But before that, we've got midterms.

records.jp: げっ！　もうそんな時期か！？
records.en_original: Ack! It's that time of year already?!
records.en: Ack! It's that time of year already?!

records.jp: ど、どうしよう、忘れてたぁ……
records.en_original: W-what should I do? I totally forgot...
records.en: W-what should I do? I totally forgot...

records.jp: ふふっ、学園祭も校外学習も中間テストも、<CR>今から楽しみです
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm excited for everything—the festival, the field trip, and even midterms!
records.en: Hehe, I'm already looking forward to<CR>the culture festival, field trip, and midterms.

records.jp: 楽しくねえだろ、テストは！
records.en_original: Come on, there's no way you think tests are fun!
records.en: Come on, there's no way you think tests are fun!

records.jp: ったく、美弦がいりゃ教えてもらえるのに、<CR>あいつ肝心な時にいねえんだよな……
records.en_original: Man, if only Mio was around! She always helps me out, but she's never there when I really need her...
records.en: Man, if only Mio was around! She always helps me out,<CR>but she's never there when I really need her...

records.jp: そういえば、お姉さんって今、どこにいるんだっけ？
records.en_original: Oh yeah, where's your big sis at these days?
records.en: Oh yeah, where's your older sister at these days?

records.jp: ＡＡＳＡのお仕事であっちこっち飛び回ってる<CR>みたいだから、詳しくはわからないんだ
records.en_original: She's off flying all over the place for AASA work, so honestly, I don't really know.
records.en: She's off flying all over the place for AASA work,<CR>so honestly, I don't really know.

records.jp: アタシは止めたんだぞ？<CR>フラグメント直ったばかりで無茶すんな、って
records.en_original: I told her not to, you know? I said, "Don't push yourself so hard right after fixing your Fragment."
records.en: I told her not to, you know?<CR>I said, "Don't push yourself so hard right after fixing your Fragment."

records.jp: 私たち以上にボロボロだったのに直しちゃうんだから、<CR>さすがは美弦さん、って感じではあるけど
records.en_original: She was even more worn out than any of us, but she went and did her thing anyway. That's just so Mio.
records.en: She was even more worn out than any of us,<CR>but she went and did her thing anyway. That's just so Mio-san.

records.jp: まあ、一人じゃ心配だけど、<CR>仁菜ちゃんが一緒だから大丈夫だと思うよ
records.en_original: If she were on her own, I'd be worried. But since she's with Niina, I think she'll be okay.
records.en: If she were on her own, I'd be worried.<CR>But since she's with Niina-chan, I think she'll be okay.

records.jp: えっ、山田仁菜もＡＡＳＡに入ったの？
records.en_original: Wait, Niina Yamada joined AASA too?
records.en: Wait, Yamada Niina joined AASA too?

records.jp: 本人は面倒くさがってたけど、生い立ちのこととか<CR>今後のこととか面倒見てくれるって条件でね
records.en_original: Yeah, she was reluctant at first, but she agreed on the condition that they'd help with stuff about her past and her future.
records.en: Yeah, she was reluctant at first, but she agreed on the condition<CR>that they'd help with stuff about her past and her future.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: へへっ、安心したか？
records.en_original: Hehe, feel better now?
records.en: Hehe, feel better now?

records.jp: うっさい、してないし！
records.en_original: No, I do NOT! Shut up!
records.en: No, I do NOT! Shut up!

records.jp: 涼楓さんと亜未琉さんは、旅行中だっけ？
records.en_original: Aren't Ryoka and Amiru traveling abroad right now?
records.en: Aren't Ryoka-san and Amiru-san traveling abroad right now?

records.jp: うん。有名な楽団のコンサートを聞きに行くって、<CR>ヨーロッパに行ってるみたい
records.en_original: Yeah, they said they were heading to Europe to see this famous orchestra in concert.
records.en: Yeah, they said they were heading to Europe to see this<CR>famous orchestra in concert.

records.jp: おいおい、あいつら学生だろ？<CR>学校サボってコンサート聞きに海外旅行かよ
records.en_original: Whoa, aren't they still students? Skipping school to fly overseas for a concert—seriously?
records.en: Whoa, aren't they still students?<CR>Skipping school to fly overseas for a concert—seriously?

records.jp: 卒業に必要な単位が取れたっていうのと、<CR>留学先の部屋探しも兼ねて、って言ってましたよ
records.en_original: They said they've already earned all the credits they need to graduate, and they're looking for a place to live while studying abroad, too.
records.en: They said they've already earned all the credits they need to graduate,<CR>and they're looking for a place to live while studying abroad, too.

records.jp: 留学！？　なにそれ、すごい！！
records.en_original: Studying abroad?! Wow, that's amazing!
records.en: Studying abroad?! Wow, that's amazing!

records.jp: ああ……けど、なんかしっくりくるよな。<CR>あの二人なら
records.en_original: Yeah...but it suits both them, don't you think?
records.en: Yeah... but somehow it feels just right.<CR>For those two, anyway.

records.jp: あはは、確かに
records.en_original: Haha, totally.
records.en: Haha, totally.

records.jp: 留学……進路かぁ……。<CR>私も、いずれ考えないといけないんだよね
records.en_original: Studying abroad... Thinking about the future... Guess I'll have to figure out my own path someday, too.
records.en: Studying abroad... Thinking about the future...<CR>Guess I'll have to figure out my own path someday, too.

records.jp: 進路……
records.en_original: The future...
records.en: The future...

records.jp: ん？　どうしたの？
records.en_original: Hm? Something up?
records.en: Hm? Something up?

records.jp: あ、いえ……私はどうしたいのか……ううん、<CR>どうなりたいのか、わからなくて……
records.en_original: Oh, um... I just don't know what I want to do... Or rather, what I want to be...
records.en: Oh, um... I just don't know what I want to do...<CR>Or rather, what I want to be...

records.jp: 慌てる必要ないんじゃない？
records.en_original: No need to rush things, okay?
records.en: No need to rush things, okay?

records.jp: ああ。どうなりたいのかなんていうのは、<CR>ここで見つけりゃいいんだよ
records.en_original: Yeah. You can figure out what you want to be right here anytime.
records.en: Yeah. You can figure out what you want to be<CR>while you're here.

records.jp: 一緒に考えよう、紫乃ちゃん。<CR>どんなことをしたいか、どんな風になりたいか、ね！
records.en_original: Let's figure it out together, Shino. What you want to do, and who you want to be!
records.en: Let's figure it out together, Shino-chan.<CR>What you want to do, and who you want to be!

records.jp: ……はいっ！
records.en_original: ...Okay!
records.en: ...Okay!

records.en_original: Ash...
records.en: Ash...

records.jp: 陽桜莉、早く行こう
records.en_original: Hiori, come on, let's get going.
records.en: Hiori, come on, let's get going.

records.jp: あ、うん！<CR>ごめんごめん！
records.en_original: Oh, right! Sorry, sorry!
records.en: Oh, right!<CR>Sorry, sorry!
